title: Missing TypeScript compilation before Vite build
reasoning: The project includes TypeScript as a devDependency and has TypeScript type definitions (@types/react, @types/react-dom, @types/formidable, @types/pdf-parse), indicating TypeScript source files. However, the build script only runs 'vite build' without a preceding type-check step. While Vite can transpile TypeScript, it does not perform type-checking during build by default. This means type errors could exist in production builds, and developers won't catch type issues until runtime or manual checking.
recommendation: Add a typecheck script using 'tsc --noEmit' and update the build script to run type-checking before building: "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit", "build": "npm run typecheck && vite build". This ensures type safety is enforced during the build process.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No tests are included in the feature's owned or context files. The tests array is empty, so there is no test coverage validating that the build process catches type errors.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a CI/CD test that introduces a deliberate TypeScript type error and verifies the build script fails, ensuring type-checking is enforced.
